archetypes.name: ci-rollup-race
archetypes.rationale: CI polling now relies on single-read observation metadata across subtle timing branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CI monitor changes for race regressions around empty check rollups, fetch failures, and startup-deadline disarming. Pay special attention to whether checks_empty and checks_observed preserve previous status decisions while avoiding duplicate gh pr checks reads. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: duplicate-pool-fallback
archetypes.rationale: The duplicate-code fallback broadens caught setup failures and must not mask worker-result failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the duplicate-code parallel fallback boundary. Confirm OSError is caught only around pool creation and submit paths, while future.result failures still flow through DuplicateCodeError and exit 2. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
